_comment: v3.0 solution template -- a solver's output for problem_template. Delete every _comment key.
_comment_objectiveValues: reported components, for comparing runs; goals are free strings.
_comment_assignments: One entry per employee. Works as a full solution (state every worker-day) OR a partial warm-start seed (state a subset; omit the rest). A non-null assignmentId is the SEED for that day and must be one of that worker-day's H_wd in the expanded problem; null = not working; an OMITTED day is open (solver decides). A seeded day is a soft starting point unless 'locked': true pins it hard (must equal the expanded day's 'forced' if it has one). Below: EMP001 10-01 is a HARD pin (locked); EMP002 10-01 is a SOFT seed; EMP003 states no days -- entirely open.
_comment_shortfalls: where coverage fell below alpha_dts [z_dts > 0]; a feasible solution may still under-cover.
